incident.summary: A visibly moving slab is perceived as meaningless because its motion is not tied to a player decision.

stageReview.failure: Contract captured moving-hard escalation but not a per-object proof that motion changes a reachable decision.
stageReview.missedControl: pressure entry lacked interactionId and decision delta
stageReview.retroControl: Every moving object must state what route/timing/cut/recovery decision it changes and how that change is signaled.

stageReview.failure: Motion amplitude/period and pathRole exist, but object-level route intersection is not enough to establish purpose.
stageReview.missedControl: No required pre/post-motion reachability and decision comparison
stageReview.retroControl: Require reachableStateWindow, interaction mode, avoid/recover branch, and decision delta for each moving object.

stageReview.failure: A moving slab can be rendered and collide while remaining gameplay-irrelevant.
stageReview.missedControl: No builder gate comparing static-vs-moving traces
stageReview.retroControl: Builder preflight must demonstrate at least one changed natural trace: cut timing, bounce direction, landing window, or recovery.

stageReview.failure: Existing QA may record x-window overlap or motion metadata without exact object interaction evidence.
stageReview.missedControl: No exact objectId natural touch/avoid/recovery row
stageReview.retroControl: Natural QA must capture the named object across observe→approach→contact/avoid and reject x-overlap-only evidence.

stageReview.failure: Prior fixes optimized dimensions and labels before proving the object’s role.
stageReview.missedControl: No stop rule for meaningless animated gameplay objects
stageReview.retroControl: If no decision delta is observed, either redesign the object into a causal obstacle/support or demote it to decorative with collider removed.

factoryChangesRequired: Add moving-object purpose contract to blueprint schema
Add static-vs-moving decision-delta check to Builder handoff
Add exact object natural interaction matrix to QA
Propagate BLOCKED when purpose or perceptual causality is unobserved
Route repeated meaningless-object feedback through formal fixer
